purpose: Form MSC-3 is an annual return filed by a dormant company to indicate its financial position duly audited by a chartered accountant in practice.
when: Within a period of thirty days from the end of each financial year
steps: Prepare the return in Form MSC-3 indicating the financial position duly audited by a chartered accountant in practice.
Pay the annual fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
File Form MSC-3 within a period of thirty days from the end of each financial year.
checklist: Ensure the company is registered as a dormant company.
Prepare the return in Form MSC-3.
Get the financial position duly audited by a chartered accountant in practice.
Arrange for the annual fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
watch: The Registrar shall initiate the process of striking off the name of the company if the company remains as a dormant company for a period of consecutive five years.
